$description: Code-side Dark values for the Depth (shadow) tokens; the Figma Dark mode is not final. In Figma the shadows use --color-opacity-* and --color-invert-opacity-*, which turn white (or navy) in Dark, so every shadow became a light glow. In Dark each of those colors is replaced, inside the shadow tokens only, by a stronger black: a shadow has to be darker than a dark surface to read as depth. Focus rings and other shadows without these colors are unchanged.
